confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain, and July is peak season for domestic and European visitors, so rates may run above off-season levels. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX figure comes from an RBA table snapshot that I could not confirm on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Moroccan urban pricing for a northern port city with tourism demand, benchmarked against Moroccan coastal and inland tourist cities such as Tetouan, Casablanca and Rabat. No web search was used for city prices.
